 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Kumar Panwar
 Oral Order
2 21-07-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner has prayed for bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 272,
273, 308, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 30(a), 32(1)(2) (3)/36/41(1)(2) of the Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act.
Prosecution case relates to recovery of one rifle, two country made pistols, nine live cartridges and four khokha and besides these recovery semi prepared pistols were also recovered.
It is further alleged that 985 litres of wine was also recovered from the same house.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
His name transpired in confessional statement of Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.42542 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 apprehended accused Beby Devi before the police, which has no evidentiary value in the eye of law.
Petitioner has no concern with the alleged recovery of arms as well as liquor.
Several accused persons have been granted bail.
Co-accused Beby Devi has already been enlarged on bail by another coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 18.12.2019 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 81279 of 2019.
He is languishing in judicial custody since 31.05.2023.
Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of Bail.
